theme.rationale: The founder demands a 'trillion dollar platform UI' with absolute realism. No AI-slop, no abstract futuristic backgrounds, no purple gradients. We are using a highly structured, high-contrast monochrome base (Zinc/Slate) reminiscent of Stripe, Linear, and Vercel, paired with industrial accents. This creates maximum authority, trust, and premium B2B utility suitable for an engineering documentation platform.

headings.usage: Use for all H1, H2, H3. Never use Inter or Roboto for headings.

body.usage: Clear, readable paragraphs and UI labels.

grid.ecosystem: grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 md:grid-cols-5 lg:grid-cols-10 gap-2 md:gap-4

buttons.primary: bg-zinc-950 text-white font-medium rounded-md px-6 py-3 hover:bg-zinc-800 transition-colors shadow-sm
buttons.secondary: bg-white text-zinc-950 border border-zinc-200 font-medium rounded-md px-6 py-3 hover:bg-zinc-50 transition-colors
buttons.investors: bg-amber-600 text-white font-medium rounded-md px-6 py-3 hover:bg-amber-700 transition-colors shadow-sm

cards.surface: bg-white border border-zinc-200 rounded-lg shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow
cards.ecosystem_item: group flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-2 md:p-4 border border-zinc-200 rounded-md bg-white hover:border-zinc-300 transition-all text-center gap-2
cards.pricing: bg-white border border-zinc-200 rounded-xl p-8 flex flex-col shadow-sm

header.wrapper: sticky top-0 z-50 bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-zinc-200

motion.hover_effects: Subtle translation (-translate-y-[2px]) and shadow elevation (shadow-md) on cards. NO wild scaling or floating.
motion.rule: Keep motion crisp, purposeful, and functional. Avoid 'bazaconii'.

media.rules: ABSOLUTE REALISM. Unsplash raw photos of engineering work, pipelines, human workers. NO AI generated abstract art, NO futuristic light beams, NO glowing purple circuits.

images.description: Person drafting on blueprint. Use with a white/transparent or subtle black overlay.
Engineers collaborating over a blueprint. Professional, realistic.
Industrial facility worker. High-quality raw industrial photo to ground the platform's reality.
Gas pipeline infrastructure. Real pipes, raw engineering context.

instructions_to_main_agent.1_global_css: Remove all purple/indigo gradients from index.css. Insert Google Fonts imports for Cabinet Grotesk (or similar bold sans) and Satoshi. Add the color variables defined in this JSON to the :root scope. Set the body background to bg-zinc-50 or bg-white.
instructions_to_main_agent.2_landing_page: Redesign Landing using strict Swiss high-contrast layout. Hero should be commanding, typography-led. Remove abstract SVG backgrounds. Use the provided Unsplash images for any photo sections. The 40+ ecosystem grid MUST be dense (grid-cols-10 on desktop) using small cards with crisp borders and grayscale images that colorize on hover.
instructions_to_main_agent.3_auth_page: Redesign `/auth` to a split-screen layout. Left side: The industrial worker image covering the full height, with a subtle dark overlay. Right side: Clean, white, centered form. GoogleLogin button at the very top of the form, prominent. Then a standard 'sau cu email' divider, followed by standard Shadcn inputs. Keep all tabs functionality.
instructions_to_main_agent.4_testing: Do NOT remove or alter any existing data-testid attributes. They are critical for the E2E tests.
instructions_to_main_agent.5_language: Keep all text in Romanian. Do not translate to English.
instructions_to_main_agent.6_platform_cohesion: Ensure that Dashboard and Gas Studio inherit the new font (Satoshi) and the new high-contrast button styles. Replace any rounded-full buttons with rounded-md.
